documentsRequired: As required on the official portal
title: Aadhar Card Download, Correction, Status 2026
vacancyDetails: Download e-Aadhaar, update demographics/biometrics, check enrolment/update status
howToApply:
1. Visit https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in or https://uidai.gov.in
2. Login with Aadhaar/VID and OTP
3. Download e-Aadhaar (masked/unmasked as needed)
4. For correction: Online Update / Book appointment at Aadhaar centre
5. Track status with EID / URN
shortDescription: Aadhaar Card download, name/address correction and status check 2026 – official services on myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.
content:
UIDAI provides online Aadhaar services including e-Aadhaar download, demographic update (name, address, DOB, mobile, email) and status tracking.

  • Portal: myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in
  • PVC Aadhaar order also available online
  • Some updates may require visit to Aadhaar Seva Kendra

Never share OTP or biometrics on unofficial websites.
